$comment: The styles ledger. IN is never listed here - registry.ts IS the in-list. OUT is every style removed for good, with the commit that removed it and the operator's own words. BACKLOG is what research proposed and nobody has rendered yet. scripts/styles-ledger.mjs checks this file both ways against the registry and the git history and renders docs/styles-ledger.md from it; the gallery's Ledger page reads it too.

out.name: Stained-glass mosaic
out.note: get rid of this style for good

backlog.name: 1-bit
backlog.look: two values only; form from silhouette, stipple and hatching
backlog.seenIn: Return of the Obra Dinn, World of Horror, Minit

backlog.name: Fantasy-console 16 colours
backlog.look: 128x128 grid, one fixed 16-colour palette, bold 1-3px clusters

backlog.name: C64 multicolour
backlog.look: double-wide pixels, 16 fixed colours, chunky dark outlines

backlog.name: Attribute-clash 8x8
backlog.look: two colours per 8x8 cell, deliberate clash at the borders, black outlines

backlog.name: EGA 16-colour
backlog.look: 320x200 feel, 16 hard RGBI colours, crosshatch dithering, stepped curves

backlog.name: VGA painterly
backlog.look: 256-colour ramps, atmospheric dither, hand-painted backdrops, selective outlines
backlog.seenIn: Monkey Island VGA, Another World, Beneath a Steel Sky

backlog.name: Arcade hand-drawn
backlog.look: large 100px+ sprites, many colours, strong outlines, dramatic highlight ramps
backlog.seenIn: Metal Slug, Street Fighter III, King of Fighters

backlog.name: 80px brawler
backlog.look: hand-drawn sprites in an 80px cell, black outlines, 3-4 tones, bright cast on muted painted backdrops, big readable attack poses
backlog.seenIn: Little Fighter 2 (our own drawing, never a trace), Golden Axe, Streets of Rage

backlog.name: Isometric pixel
backlog.look: 2:1 stair-step diagonals, tile diamond ground, patterned shadows

backlog.name: Chunky 32x32
backlog.look: 16-32px sprites blown up, thick outlines, details abstracted to a few clusters

backlog.name: Pre-rendered to pixel
backlog.look: a shaded 3D form quantised to a pixel grid: plastic highlights, real perspective

backlog.name: Rotoscoped pixel
backlog.look: natural anatomy and timing traced from motion, then hard-clustered; few colours
backlog.seenIn: Prince of Persia, Flashback, Another World

backlog.name: Pixel sprites in a lit scene
backlog.look: cluster-shaded sprites over a scene with depth of field, bloom and real light

backlog.name: Rubber-hose 1930s
backlog.look: bendy limbs, pie-cut eyes, inked outlines, film grain, sepia-leaning palette
backlog.seenIn: Cuphead, Bendy and the Ink Machine

backlog.name: Anime cel
backlog.look: flat stepped shadows, clean contours, graphic highlights, speed lines

backlog.name: Ink and wash
backlog.look: brush contours with dry-brush breaks, ink bleeds, paper ground, earthy colours

backlog.name: Graphic-novel line
backlog.look: strong contour drawing, selective hatching, flat or lightly modelled colour

backlog.name: Thick-line cartoon
backlog.look: bold black outlines, elastic poses, bright flat fills, simplified anatomy

backlog.name: Chibi big-head
backlog.look: 2-3 heads tall, huge face read, compact silhouettes, comic tone
backlog.seenIn: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon, Kingdom Hearts Re:coded

backlog.name: Gouache storybook
backlog.look: opaque matte brush layers, luminous atmosphere, soft edges

backlog.name: Noir high contrast
backlog.look: near-monochrome, hard light against shadow, venetian-blind lighting, silhouettes
backlog.seenIn: MadWorld, The Wolf Among Us, Obra Dinn

backlog.name: Woodblock print
backlog.look: flattened perspective, decorative patterning, printed-ink palette, wave and cloud motifs

backlog.name: Shadow puppet
backlog.look: solid dark masses, rim light, fog, sparse backgrounds, big negative space

backlog.name: Comic halftone
backlog.look: thick contours, Ben-Day dots, offset misregistration, saturated colour blocks

backlog.name: Risograph
backlog.look: two or three inks overprinted, grain, registration drift, rough edges
backlog.seenIn: The Case of the Golden Idol, Overboard!

backlog.name: Constructivist poster
backlog.look: red-black-cream, monumental blocks, stark diagonals, bold sans type
backlog.seenIn: Papers Please, Beholder, This War of Mine

backlog.name: Art deco / dieselpunk
backlog.look: stepped ornament, brass and bakelite, symmetrical interiors, jewel tones on black

backlog.name: Chalkboard
backlog.look: white and pastel chalk strokes with dust on a dark green or black board

backlog.name: Felt and plush
backlog.look: fuzzy edges, visible stitching, button eyes, soft fabric shading
backlog.seenIn: LittleBigPlanet, Yoshi's Woolly World, Kirby's Epic Yarn

backlog.name: Cross-stitch
backlog.look: every pixel an X of thread on aida cloth; a pixel style wearing fabric

backlog.name: Flash-era vector
backlog.look: crisp vector outlines, simple gradients, elastic web-cartoon timing
backlog.seenIn: Fancy Pants, Alien Hominid, Dad 'n Me

backlog.name: Neon vector arcade
backlog.look: glowing wireframes on black, additive light, particle trails

backlog.name: Low-poly faceted
backlog.look: flat-shaded triangles, no textures, orthographic calm
backlog.seenIn: A Short Hike, Kentucky Route Zero, Monument Valley
